character: Largest downhill in the Jura (40 km). Cross-country paradise.
name: Métabief
description: 35km of pistes, 10 lifts, but the largest downhill domain in the Jura. On the Swiss border near Pontarlier. Mont d'Or summit (1,463m). Cross-country (100km+). Good for families, day trips from Geneva (50 min).
